narrator.description: Warm, calm Bangladeshi male storyteller in his early thirties from Dhaka, speaking standard Bangla (Bengali). Soft, intimate, emotionally expressive delivery like a late-night radio storyteller. Clear diction, gentle unhurried pacing, rich mid-low tone.

young_man.description: Bangladeshi young man around 25, earnest and friendly, natural conversational Bangla (Bengali), clear and slightly energetic.

man.description: Bangladeshi father around 45, steady warm baritone, natural everyday Bangla (Bengali), caring but firm.

old_man.description: Elderly Bangladeshi man around 68, slightly raspy and slow, dignified, natural Bangla (Bengali) with a fatherly warmth.

young_woman.description: Bangladeshi young woman around 25, soft, warm and sincere voice, natural Bangla (Bengali).

woman.description: Bangladeshi mother around 42, calm, caring and gentle voice, natural Bangla (Bengali).

old_woman.description: Elderly Bangladeshi grandmother around 65, gentle, slightly shaky, affectionate voice, natural Bangla (Bengali).

teen_boy.description: Bangladeshi teenage boy around 15, youthful bright voice not yet deep, natural Bangla (Bengali), expressive.

teen_girl.description: Bangladeshi teenage girl around 14, youthful soft and clear voice, natural Bangla (Bengali), expressive.

child_boy.description: Young Bangladeshi boy around 8, high-pitched playful childlike voice, natural Bangla (Bengali).

child_girl.description: Young Bangladeshi girl around 8, high-pitched sweet childlike voice, natural Bangla (Bengali).

voice_sample_bn: আমাদের চারপাশে প্রতিদিন অসংখ্য গল্প ঘটে। কেউ চুপচাপ ভালোবাসে, কেউ না বলে কষ্ট পায়, আবার কেউ ছোট্ট একটা কাজ দিয়ে পুরো পরিবারের মন বদলে দেয়। আজ তেমনই একটা গল্প শোনাব— যেটা হয়তো তোমার নিজের জীবনেরও গল্প।
_schedule_note: One video every 6 hours (Asia/Dhaka). GitHub Actions runs ~35 min before each slot (see .github/workflows/daily.yml cron) and schedules the upload for the exact slot time; a late run publishes immediately.
